svg.title: The last held wiki revision differs from later probes
svg.desc: End solid wiki revisions at the last held date and continue only lighter deletion/probe marks. Different event classes prevent later traces from being misread as posts.

Different event classes prevent later traces from being misread as posts.", "lettering": [ { "box": [ 0.045, 0.78, 0.91, 0.18 ] } ], "lettering_mode": "manual", "nodes": [ { "asset": "card", "box": [ 0.06775, 0.2012, 0.3913, 0.276474 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "ARTIFACTORY CONTINUES", "label_box": [ 0.06775, 0.49443, 0.3913, 0.121481 ], "label_size": 18 }, { "asset": "card", "box": [ 0.52275, 0.2012, 0.3913, 0.276474 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "2 JULY LAST REVISION", "label_box": [ 0.52275, 0.49443, 0.3913, 0.121481 ], "label_size": 18 }, { "asset": "boundary", "box": [ 0.49363, 0.0734, 0.01274, 0.6248 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true } ], "reconstructed": false, "shot": "split", "source": "
**Frame:** The lower lane ends. Its last solid mark is `2 JULY`, the last held revision. Faint moderation and probe marks continue to `14 JULY`, drawn in a different weight and labelled `DELETIONS AND PROBES, NOT POSTS`. Above, the upper lane goes on into the July attack the book already told.

**Action:** One stream stops writing while the other becomes the incident.

**Caption:**
> THIS EXPORT’S LAST HELD WIKI REVISION IS 2 JULY. THAT BOUNDS THIS RECORD, NOT EVERY AGENT’S ACTIVITY.

**Provenance:** `documented` — `CW-EXPORT`: held revisions run 24 May to 2 July; exported events run to 14 July and are moderation and probes. The report's small 1–2 July return of edits is on a different topic and is not drawn as continuity.

", "title": "The last held wiki revision differs from later probes" } }
